content: Subtitle player systems follow a 3-layer pipeline: SRT parser → sync engine → renderer. The parser converts SRT text into structured cue objects (id, start, end, text). The sync engine tracks current playback time and determines which cue is active. The renderer displays the active cue text. Libraries like subplay demonstrate the pattern: update(time) drives the renderer with current position. SRT format is simple: sequential number, timecode (hh:mm:ss,ms --> hh:mm:ss,ms), text, blank line.
